prompt: Bug in Config Service app-namespace cache (`AppNamespaceServiceWithCache`). When an app namespace is deleted and a new one is created with the same appId and name, the periodic scan of deleted records removes the cache entry for that appId+name — which by then is the NEW app namespace. Clients then stop seeing a namespace that exists. When handling deleted app namespaces, only evict the cache entry if the cached app namespace is the same record (same id) as the deleted one.

oracle_plan.instruction: In the deleted-records handling, look up the cached entry by key and remove it only when its id equals the deleted id.
